Rules.InvariantScript:
CountRows(
    Filter(
        Equipment_Tickets,
        Title in colBkAssets.Value,
        IsBlank(ResolvedDate)
    )
) & ""

"Already booked. " & lblBkConflictCount.Text &
 " other booking(s) overlap this period - see the list at the bottom of this form."

"Open issue: " & lblBkIssueCount.Text &
 " unresolved report(s) on the device(s) in this booking."

ThisItem.Value & " - " &
 Coalesce(
     LookUp(Equipment_Assets, Titel = ThisItem.Value).DeviceName,
     "?"
 ) & "   x"

With(
    { q: Lower(Trim(txtBkAssetSearch.Text)) },
    FirstN(
        Sort(
            Filter(
                Equipment_Assets,
                !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(Titel, ""))))
                    || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(DeviceName, ""))))
                    || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(Manufacturer, ""))))
                    || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(SerialNumber, ""))))
            ),
            Titel
        ),
        25
    )
)
If(Parent.Width < 600, "Search ID, device, maker", "Type to search by ID, device or manufacturer")

Coalesce(
    LookUp(
        Equipment_Assets,
        'CurrentLocation (CurrentLocation0)'.Value = drpBkRoom.Selected.Value
    ).CurrentCampus.Value,
    LookUp(
        Equipment_Setups,
        CurrentLocation.Value = drpBkRoom.Selected.Value
    ).CurrentCampus.Value,
    ""
)

If(
    IsBlank(drpBkRoom.Selected.Value), "",
    IsBlank(lblBkCampusValue.Text),
        "Campus unknown for this room",
    "Campus: " & lblBkCampusValue.Text
)
"e.g. PhD Jansen - membrane fouling, or a course code"

Filter(
    Equipment_Bookings,
    Title in colBkAssets.Value,
    ID <> varCurrentBooking.ID,
    StartDate <= varBkEnd,
    EndDate >= varBkStart
)

ThisItem.Title & "   |   " &
 Text(ThisItem.StartDate, DateTimeFormat.ShortDate) & " to " &
 Text(ThisItem.EndDate, DateTimeFormat.ShortDate) &
 "   |   " & Coalesce(ThisItem.ReservedBy.DisplayName, "?")

If(
    ThisItem.CellDate = If(varPickTarget = "start", varBkStart, varBkEnd),
        RGBA(0, 120, 212, 1),
    ThisItem.CellDate = Today(), RGBA(222, 236, 249, 1),
    RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1)
)

If(
    ThisItem.CellDate = If(varPickTarget = "start", varBkStart, varBkEnd),
        RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1),
    Not(ThisItem.InMonth), RGBA(200, 198, 196, 1),
    RGBA(50, 49, 48, 1)
)
